01

“separating (munfakkin)”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 98:1).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
separating (munfakkin) [al-Bayyinah: 1], meaning: “ceasing [from their disbelief]; he says: They would not have believed until the truth became clear to them.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
مُنْفَكِّينَ [البينة: 1] ، يَعْنِي: " مُنْتَهِينَ، يَقُولُ: «لَمْ يَكُونُوا لِيُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْحَقُّ»
